definition.description:
Context:

- document (StudioDocument | null): the open document, kept current as the user or the assistant edits it.
- blocks (Block[]): the parsed blocks of document.content; index-based ids regenerated on every parse.
- renderCache (Record<string, RenderResult>): Mermaid render results keyed by diagram source, so unchanged diagrams are not rendered again.
- selection (string | null): the selected block id, reported in the host context.
- pending (PendingDocumentAction | null): the host action being executed: call id, the session it belongs to, the parsed action and the block its result names.
- saveError (string | null): why the last save to IndexedDB failed.
- retryCount (number): automatic retries started for this draft; resets on success, new edits, document changes or manual retry.

closed.description: No document is open; the centre pane shows the file list state.

applying.description:
Transient: routes the pending host action.
- invalid arguments: reply failed
- create_document / open_document / rename_document: their own states
- block edits: apply, then save and render
- an edit without an open document: reply failed

always.description: Arguments did not validate against the declared schema.
create_document: write a new document that adopts the calling session.
open_document: find it by id or name.

Rename the open document, save, then reply.

Actions:
- renameOpenFromPending: apply the requested name
- resetRetries: start a fresh save budget
rename_document on another document: update it in the store.

Apply the block edit, then save and render.

Actions:
- applyPendingEdit: update content, blocks and selection
- resetRetries: start a fresh save budget
A block edit that references an unknown block.
A block edit with no document open.

resuming.description: Transient: return to the open document, or to closed.

creating.description: Writing the new document to IndexedDB. Invokes creator.

xstate.done.actor.0.document.creating.description: Created: open it, tell the app, then render and reply.

xstate.error.actor.0.document.creating.description: The store refused the write; the assistant is told.

finding.description: Looking the document up by id or name and moving the conversation to it. Invokes finder.

xstate.done.actor.0.document.finding.description: Found: open it, tell the app, then render and reply.

xstate.error.actor.0.document.finding.description: The store could not be read.

renaming.description: Renaming a document that is not the open one. Invokes renamer.

xstate.done.actor.0.document.renaming.description: Renamed: tell the app and reply.

xstate.error.actor.0.document.renaming.description: The store could not be written.

open.description: A document is open. Substates save and render; the pending host action is answered once rendering is done.

rendering.description: Rendering the diagrams whose source is not cached. Invokes renderer.

xstate.done.actor.0.document.open.render.description: The draft rendered but storage failed; begin bounded save recovery without declaring success.
Rendered; a pending host action gets its result now.

xstate.error.actor.0.document.open.rende.description: Record the renderer failure while the unsaved draft enters save recovery.
Mermaid itself failed; the affected diagrams are marked and the action still replies.
Mermaid itself failed; the affected diagrams are marked.

saving.description:
One IndexedDB write is in flight.
- current: no newer draft
- changed: keep edits in memory until this write settles, then save the latest draft

current.description: The in-flight write contains the current draft.

changed.description: The user edited during the write; its completion cannot mark the newer draft saved.

user.edit.description:
Keep the new draft while the existing write finishes.

Actions:
- editContent: retain and reparse the latest draft
- resetRetries: give the new draft a fresh retry budget

user.rename.description:
Keep the new name while the existing write finishes.

Actions:
- renameOpen: update the draft name
- resetRetries: give the new draft a fresh retry budget

xstate.done.actor.0.document.open.saving.description: An older draft committed; report that write and immediately save the newest draft in a new invocation.

The current draft committed; render it.

Actions:
- clearSaveError: clear the error only after storage succeeds
- resetRetries: reset the automatic retry budget
- reportSaved: notify the app of the persisted document

xstate.error.actor.0.document.open.savin.description: An older write failed; preserve the error and debounce the new draft without overlapping writes.
The current write failed; retain the draft and error, render, then enter bounded recovery.

saveFailed.description: The rendered draft is still unsaved. Two automatic retries precede a manual fallback.

retrying.description: Wait briefly before another save, unless the automatic retry budget is exhausted.

xstate.after.saveRetry.document.open.sav.description: Start the next bounded retry of the current draft.

always.description:
Storage retries exhausted during a host action; show the manual fallback.

Actions:
- replySaveFailed: report the persistence failure once
- clearPending: finish the host action
Automatic retries exhausted; keep the draft for manual recovery.

after.description: Start the next bounded retry of the current draft.

failed.description: Automatic saves stopped. Keep the draft in this tab and let the user retry after fixing storage.

user.retrySave.description: The user retries the current draft with a fresh automatic retry budget.

dirty.description: Unsaved user edits; saves after a short pause in typing.

app.open.description: The app switches to another document.

app.close.description: The app closed the document (deleted, or back to the list).

app.sync.description: The document was renamed from the sidebar; keep the name current.

user.edit.description:
Schedule a save after typing pauses.

Actions:
- editContent: update the draft and reparse blocks
- resetRetries: give the new draft a fresh retry budget

user.select.description: The user selected a block in the preview.

user.rename.description:
Save the user's new document name.

Actions:
- renameOpen: update the name
- resetRetries: start a fresh save budget

app.execute.description: The assistant called a host action. Records it and decides how to run it.

tools.name: list_actors
tools.title: List Actors
tools.description: List all registered XState actors with summary information including current state, status, and child count.

status.description: Filter actors by status. Omit to return all actors.

tools.name: get_actor_state
tools.title: Get Actor State
tools.description: Get the full current snapshot for a specific XState actor, including state value, context, and status.

excludeContext.description: If true, replaces context with '[excluded]' to reduce output size

contextMaxChars.description: Truncate serialized context to this many characters. Adds '[truncated, full size: N]' suffix.

tools.name: get_event_history
tools.title: Get Event History
tools.description: Get recent events for an XState actor from the ring buffer. Returns events in chronological order.

tools.name: get_machine_definition
tools.title: Get Machine Definition
tools.description: Get the XState machine's JSON definition including states, transitions, guards, and actions.

tools.name: clear_actors
tools.title: Clear Actors
tools.description: Discard retained inspection data and pending commands. Does not stop application actors. Available in application read-only mode.

tools.name: get_actor_tree
tools.title: Get Actor Tree
tools.description: Get the hierarchical tree of all actors showing parent-child relationships, current states, and statuses.

tools.name: can_handle_event
tools.title: Can Handle Event
tools.description: Check whether an actor can handle a given event type in its current state. Performs static analysis of the machine definition — guards are not evaluated.

tools.name: get_state_timeline
tools.title: Get State Timeline
tools.description: Get the history of state transitions for an actor, showing from/to state values and triggering events.

tools.name: send_event
tools.title: Send Event
tools.description: Send an application event (may cause destructive external side effects). Requires explicit server and adapter write permission. Target can be a sessionId or actor name. Success acknowledges dispatch only; verify the resulting state separately.

target.description: Actor sessionId or name (name resolution tries sessionId first, then actor name)

event.description: The event to send (must have a 'type' field, e.g. { type: 'SUBMIT', data: ... })
